neighbours.label: A spatial direction or vista adverbial: gazing or extending toward a distant point (all the way up and down, far off, skyward, toward the horizon, 远方)
fire: From the ridge she looked out across the valley toward the far hills.
The road ran straight up over the pass and out of sight.
Smoke drifted skyward from the chimneys of the village.
The trail dropped steeply down into the gorge below us.
On a clear day you can see all the way out to the islands.
The geese flew off toward the horizon in a long line.
Lights stretched away along the shore as far as the eye could follow.
他站在山顶上，望向远处的村庄。
quiet: The committee came out in favour of the new proposal.
The question is still up for debate among the members.
Prices drifted downward after the announcement in March.
The meeting ran down the list of complaints one by one.
They stayed out of the argument all the way through dinner.
The company is working toward a settlement with the union.
He read the contract along with the attached schedule.
她把文件放在桌子上，然后离开了。
